content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Safe Casts and Explicit Casts** as part of **Null Safety and Type Handling**. Apply safe casts and explicit casts by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—The as Operator, The as? Operator, Handling Failed Casts—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Functions, null safety, strings, and collections are the building blocks of most practical Kotlin code. Choosing the right operation reduces avoidable errors and makes behavior easier to test.
